headline_marked: BWDB engineer and wife [[placed on remand for killing child help]] in Dhanmondi
headline: BWDB engineer and wife placed on remand for killing child help in Dhanmondi
summary: A Dhaka court has ordered a two-day remand for Md Sabibur Rahman and Farah Nusrat after a child domestic worker was allegedly pushed from a building to her death.
details: A Dhaka court has placed Md Sabibur Rahman, an additional chief engineer of the Bangladesh Water Development Board (BWDB), and his wife Farah Nusrat on a two-day remand.
The couple is accused of pushing a child domestic help, Rikta Moni, from a building on 9/A Road in Dhanmondi to her death.
Police recovered the girl's body from the building premises around 6 am on Friday.
The victim's father, a day labourer from Sunamganj, filed a lawsuit against the couple following the discovery of the body.
Investigating Officer Shahnewaz Bappi had sought a 10-day remand to question the suspects, though the court granted two days.
The defense lawyer opposed the petition for remand, seeking bail for the suspects instead.
caption:
A child domestic worker was allegedly pushed from a building to her death in Dhanmondi. Now, a BWDB engineer and his wife are on remand.

A Dhaka court has placed Md Sabibur Rahman, an additional chief engineer of the Bangladesh Water Development Board (BWDB), and his wife Farah Nusrat on a two-day remand.

The couple is accused of pushing a child domestic help, Rikta Moni, from a building on 9/A Road in Dhanmondi to her death.

Police recovered the girl's body from the building premises around 6 am on Friday.

The victim's father, a day labourer from Sunamganj, filed a lawsuit against the couple following the discovery of the body.

Investigating Officer Shahnewaz Bappi had sought a 10-day remand to question the suspects, though the court granted two days.

The defense lawyer opposed the petition for remand, seeking bail for the suspects instead.

#Bangladesh #Dhaka #Dhanmondi #Justice #CrimeNews
